WeGoUp Coach | AI-Powered Career Growth Coach

# Gaps fall flat. AI moves you forward.

Career advice today is either too generic or too expensive. WeGoUp Coach closes that gap — providing precise skill gap analysis, personalized learning paths, and interview-ready action plans.

Job Seekers Career Changers In-Role Professionals Recent Graduates

## One Growth Platform.

Each module is a specialized AI Agent powered by Google Gemini, collaborating through our Orchestrator to deliver comprehensive career intelligence.

### Skill Gap Quantification Engine

Upload your resume and target job description. Our Agentic RAG pipeline parses both with Gemini, embeds them into vector space via Vertex AI, and computes precise cosine similarity scores — producing an interactive skill heatmap showing exactly where your gaps are.

1

Resume & LinkedIn profile parsing via Gemini Document AI

2

JD semantic extraction (skills, seniority signals, tech stack)

3

Vector comparison via Vertex AI Search

4

Gap severity scoring by market frequency & hire impact

Personalized

### Automated Learning Path Generator

Gemini 3.1 Pro generates structured, project-based learning blueprints for every identified skill gap. Each item includes resource type, estimated hours, and a validation milestone.

1

Course, open-source project, and book recommendations

2

Estimated hours and validation milestones per skill

3

Dynamic re-prioritization as you learn

4

Progress tracking with visual timeline

Adaptive AI

### Interactive Interview Simulator

Practice mock interviews with an AI agent that generates context-aware questions based on your target role and identified gaps. Real-time feedback on structure, accuracy & clarity.

1

2

Real-time feedback on structure, accuracy & clarity

4

### AI Resume Enhancement

Our Resume Agent analyzes your resume against target JD vocabulary and ATS keyword requirements. It suggests phrasing improvements and generates tailored variants for different roles.

Phrasing improvements and quantification suggestions

Continuous integration of live job market trends, company culture profiles, tech stack data, and hiring patterns — all retrieved via Vertex AI Search for high-precision semantic queries.

3

4

Skill taxonomy with semantic synonym matching

## A structured pipeline, not a chatbot.

Every step is powered by specialized AI Agents working through our Orchestrator.

Upload your resume (PDF) or paste your LinkedIn profile. Gemini Document AI extracts your skills, experience, and career trajectory into structured data.

Gemini 3 Flash + Google Cloud Storage

### Target & Analyze

Input your target role and company. The Gap Analysis Agent retrieves matching JDs, embeds both profiles into vector space, and computes similarity scores.

Vertex AI Search + Gemini 3.1 Pro

### Learn & Practice

Receive a personalized learning path with estimated hours and milestones. Practice with adaptive mock interviews. Optimize your resume for ATS.

Multi-Agent Orchestration Pipeline

### Track & Improve

Monitor your progress on an interactive dashboard. The skill heatmap updates as you complete learning items and practice interviews.
